attractions.name: Paro (Rinpung) Dzong
attractions.description: Fortress of Jewels, built of stone rather than clay. Excellent example of 15th-century architecture and one of the most impressive dzongs in Bhutan. Currently the government center of Paro.

attractions.name: Ta Dzong (National Museum of Bhutan)
attractions.description: Cylindrical watchtower built in 1649 on a hill above Paro Dzong, converted to the National Museum in 1968. The spiral-shaped building holds antiques, art, textiles, weapons and household items telling Bhutan's history.

attractions.name: Kyichu Lhakhang
attractions.description: One of the oldest temples in Bhutan, built in the 7th century by the Tibetan Emperor.

attractions.name: Tiger's Nest (Taktsang Monastery)
attractions.description: Most popular site in Bhutan, built on a 900 meter high cliff. Prayer flags adorn the cliffs; this is where Guru Padmasambhava landed on the back of a tigress in the 8th century. The hike to the cafeteria viewpoint offers a stunning view of the monastery.
attractions.recommended_duration: 1 hour hike to the cafeteria viewpoint
